competitorWins: Explore.org is the deeper nature-camera experience by far: carefully placed wildlife cameras with expert curation — the Brooks Falls brown bear cameras are the famous example — plus live nature chats, highlights, educational programming and a dedicated community of wildlife watchers, all run as a philanthropic project. For watching animals live, learning from naturalists, or following a season at a specific nest or river, its focused, mission-driven depth beats any generalist globe.
description: Explore.org is a free live nature and wildlife webcam network — cameras such as the Brooks Falls bear cams — run philanthropically by the Annenberg Foundation's Explore initiative. It has no general map, flight, ship or satellite tracking. WorldEye is complementary for breadth: 74,229 public cameras on a free 3D globe together with live flights, satellites, ships, weather, earthquakes and wildfires — no signup needed.
